title: Template Demo
tagline: The standard demo frame around a placeholder stage.
summary: A minimal demo built from the demo-kit template. Copy it into a project's demo/ folder, fill in this manifest and replace the placeholder stage.
about:
This is the **demo-kit template**: the standard frame around a placeholder stage. The stage traces a [Lissajous curve](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lissajous_curve), x = sin(a·t + π/2), y = sin(b·t), and the controls change the ratio a : b and the speed.

To start a project's demo, copy this folder into the project's `demo/`, fill in `public/manifest.json` and replace the drawing code in `src/main.js`.
